ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across approximately 85% of the surface area, with high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels localized at the distal tips and along trailing edge margins.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast light grey mottling and fine radiating streaks originating from the mid-lobe region and extending to the distal tips. Distinct contiguous white patch visible on the far right tip margin.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped central depression with well-defined linear interior boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular serrations (jagged peaks and valleys) along the entire continuous linear boundary of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the upper trailing margins tapering to sharp, elongated distal points.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast white circular pixel clusters visible on the outer margin of the left lobe and the trailing edge of the right lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Prominent parallel dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) crossing the right lobe mid-section diagonally and several shorter parallel marks on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel rake mark scarring consistent across both lobes; significant jagged irregularities on the trailing edge suggesting substantial historical tissue wear or trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: Radiating white lineations starting from the central dark mass and spreading toward the trailing edge serrations, creating a high-contrast 'combed' visual texture.
